text:
lucy: Heads up — I'm arriving in Toronto Wed eve for the offsite. Staying near King & Bathurst. Looking for something quick and not too loud for 6 people around 7pm. Any King West recs? Prefer pizza/wood-fired, tapas, or something with sharable plates.

omar: Love Gusto 101 for wood-fired pizza, usually fast if you call ahead. Small plates too.

kevin: Bar Isabel is amazing but can be slow/crowded. If you want speedy + casual, check out Kibo (ramen) or Ramen Isshin.

dina: Also Wvrst is fun if folks want sausages and beer outside. Not fancy but quick.

lucy: Budget friendly ok. Any spots that take a 6-top without a ridiculous wait?

omar: Gusto will seat a 6 if you reserve. Kibo/Ramen are walk-in only and might split you up.

kevin: Quick poll: :pizza: Gusto 101 (pizza), :meat_on_bone: Wvrst (sausages + beer), :ramen: Ramen Isshin (fast), :tada: Bar Isabel (fancier)

dina: :pizza:

omar: :pizza: (I can DM the manager for a small reservation)

lucy: :pizza: sounds great. Can you grab a res, omar? Also need one highchair for a guest who swings by with a kid.

omar: On it  I'll call now and update the thread.

ops-bot: calendar: Event "King West Dinner  Lucy + team" Wed 19:00-20:30 provisional created. Attendees: lucy, omar, kevin, dina.

omar: Confirmed 6pm res at Gusto 101 for 6 people, ask for table under the skylight. They said bring any dietary notes.

lucy: Perfect, thanks! Quick addresses in case anyone needs: ```Gusto 101  101 Portland St, Toronto, ON
Wvrst  609 King St W, Toronto, ON
Ramen Isshin  123 King St W, Toronto, ON```

kevin: If anyone wants to do pre-dinner drinks, meet at the hotel lobby at 18:10 and we'll walk over.

dina: I'll bring the kid booster seat just in case. Thanks Omar!

lucy: Appreciate the help y'all. See you Wed :airplane::stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
